tldr: Sun in the 6th house: identity and vitality center on work, health, and routine
body: Sun in the 6th house: identity and vitality center on work, health, and routine. Gift: you shine there. Watch: ego tied to it. With the Sun in the 6th house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through daily work, health, habits, service, maintenance, and labor. This makes how your days are built and whether your routine supports the life you say you want a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through rhythm and service.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in rhythm and service.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
